utility.notes: Sausalito is a well-documented Marin County city within PG&E's core Northern California service territory.

value.name: MCE (Marin Clean Energy)
value.notes: MCE's own service-area page confirms Sausalito as one of Marin County's member communities. PG&E continues to deliver the power and provide billing/customer service.

interconnection_url.notes: PG&E's own utility-wide Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Sausalito/Marin County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.

required_documents.notes: The city provides a Checklist for Expedited Solar Permitting and states all documents required for expedited applications are on its website, but the specific document list was not directly enumerated in the content reviewed this session.

value: Only one inspection is required, performed by the City Building Department, for small residential rooftop solar energy systems eligible for expedited review
A separate fire inspection may be performed by the Sausalito Fire Department
Inspections are scheduled within two business days of a request, with a two-hour inspection window

other_conditions: Electronic submittal of permit applications and documents by email and/or facsimile is available
